6880-the-coming-of-bill.description: A book by P. G. Wodehouse. If you are ignorant of Lora Delane Porter’s books that is your affair. Perhaps you are more to be pitied than censured. Nature probably gave you the wrong shape of forehead. Porter herself would have put it down to some atavistic tendency or pre-natal influence. She put most things down to that.

arxiv-2210-07035.title: Tensor Hypercontraction Form of the Perturbative Triples Energy in Coupled-Cluster Theory
arxiv-2210-07035.creator: Andy Jiang, Justin M. Turney, Henry F. Schaefer III
arxiv-2210-07035.description: Abstract We present the working equations for a reduced-scaling method of evaluating the perturbative triples (T) energy in coupled-cluster theory, through the tensor hypercontraction (THC) of the triples amplitudes ( t i ​ j ​ k a ​ b ​ c t_{ijk}^{abc} ).

arxiv-2301-09108.title: Early Warning Software for Emergency Department Crowding
arxiv-2301-09108.creator: Jalmari Tuominen, Teemu Koivistoinen, Juho Kanniainen, Niku Oksala, Ari Palomäki, Antti Roine
arxiv-2301-09108.description: Abstract Emergency department (ED) crowding is a well-recognized threat to patient safety and it has been repeatedly associated with increased mortality. Accurate forecasts of future service demand could lead to better resource management and has the potential to improve treatment outcomes.

arxiv-2312-11541.title: CLIPSyntel : CLIP and LLM Synergy for Multimodal Question Summarization in Healthcare
arxiv-2312-11541.creator: Akash Ghosh, Arkadeep Acharya, Raghav Jain, Sriparna Saha, Aman Chadha, Setu Sinha
arxiv-2312-11541.description: Abstract In the era of modern healthcare, swiftly generating medical question summaries is crucial for informed and timely patient care. Despite the increasing complexity and volume of medical data, existing studies have focused solely on text-based summarization, neglecting the integration of visual information.

arxiv-2402-12001.title: A Survey on Extractive Knowledge Graph Summarization: Applications, Approaches, Evaluation, and Future Directions
arxiv-2402-12001.creator: Xiaxia Wang, Gong Cheng
arxiv-2402-12001.description: Abstract With the continuous growth of large Knowledge Graphs (KGs), extractive KG summarization becomes a trending task. Aiming at distilling a compact subgraph with condensed information, it facilitates various downstream KG-based tasks. In this survey paper, we are among the first to provide a systematic overview of its applications and define a taxonomy for existing methods from its interdisciplinary studies.

arxiv-2403-12541.title: Marlin : Knowledge-Driven Analysis of Provenance Graphs for Efficient and Robust Detection of Cyber Attacks
arxiv-2403-12541.creator: Zhenyuan Li*, Yangyang Wei*, Xiangmin Shen † , Lingzhi Wang † , Yan Chen † , Haitao Xu*, Shouling Ji*, Fan Zhang*, Liang Hou ¶ , Wenmao Liu ‡ , Xuhong Zhang*, Jianwei Ying*
arxiv-2403-12541.description: Abstract . Recent research in both academia and industry has validated the effectiveness of provenance graph-based detection for advanced cyber attack detection and investigation. However, analyzing large-scale provenance graphs often results in substantial overhead. To improve performance, existing detection systems implement various optimization strategies.

arxiv-2407-01800.title: Normalization and effective learning rates in reinforcement learning
arxiv-2407-01800.creator: Clare Lyle, Zeyu Zheng, Khimya Khetarpal, James Martens, Hado van Hasselt, Razvan Pascanu, Will Dabney
arxiv-2407-01800.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Clare Lyle, Zeyu Zheng, Khimya Khetarpal, James Martens, Hado van Hasselt, Razvan Pascanu, Will Dabney. Normalization layers have recently experienced a renaissance in the deep reinforcement learning and continual learning literature, with several works highlighting diverse benefits such as improving loss landscape conditioning and combatting overestimation bias. However, normalization brings with it a subtle but important side effect: an equivalence between growth in the norm of the network parameters and decay in the effective learning rate.

arxiv-2504-07949.title: InteractAvatar: Modeling Hand-Face Interaction in Photorealistic Avatars with Deformable Gaussians
arxiv-2504-07949.creator: Kefan Chen, Sreyas Mohan *, Justin Theiss *, Sergiu Oprea *, Srinath Sridhar, Aayush Prakash
arxiv-2504-07949.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kefan Chen, Sreyas Mohan *, Justin Theiss *, Sergiu Oprea *, Srinath Sridhar, Aayush Prakash. With increasing interest in digital avatars coupled with the importance of expressions and gestures in communication, modeling natural avatar behavior remains an important challenge in many industries such as teleconferencing, gaming, and AR/VR.

arxiv-2506-20193.title: Microquasar jet-cocoon systems as PeVatrons
arxiv-2506-20193.creator: B. Theodore Zhang 1,2, Shigeo S. Kimura 3,4, Kohta Murase 5,6
arxiv-2506-20193.description: Abstract The origin of Galactic cosmic rays (CRs), particularly around the knee region ( ∼ \sim 3 PeV), remains a major unsolved question. Recent observations by LHAAASO suggest that the knee is shaped mainly by protons, with a transition to heavier elements at higher energies.

arxiv-2510-05540.title: Monitoring of 3C 286 with ALMA, IRAM, and SMA from 2006 to 2025: Stability, Synchrotron Ages, and Frequency-Dependent Polarization Attributed to Core-Shift
arxiv-2510-05540.creator: Minchul Kam, Hiroshi Nagai, Motoki Kino, Keiichi Asada, Rüdiger Kneissl, Iván Agudo, Sascha Trippe, Seiji Kameno, Ioannis Myserlis, Ramprasad Rao, Hojin Cho, Richard A. Perley, Bryan J. Butler, Mark Gurwell, Tomoki Matsuoka, Jongho Park, Carolina Casadio, Baltasar Vila Vilaro, Celia Verdugo, Matias
arxiv-2510-05540.description: Abstract We present the results of multi-frequency monitoring of the radio quasar 3C 286, conducted using three instruments: ALMA at 91.5, 103.5, 233.0, and 343.4 GHz, the IRAM 30-m Telescope at 86 and 229 GHz, and SMA at 225 GHz.

Most prior studies have focused on adipose tissue as the source of obesity-associated inflammation. Increasing evidence links intestinal bacteria to devel

pmc-11350971.title: Contribution of homoeologous exchange to domestication of polyploid Brassica
pmc-11350971.creator: Tianpeng Wang, Aalt D J van Dijk, Ranze Zhao, Guusje Bonnema, Xiaowu Wang
pmc-11350971.description: BackgroundPolyploidy is widely recognized as a significant evolutionary force in the plant kingdom, contributing to the diversification of plants. One of the notable features of allopolyploidy is the occurrence of homoeologous exchange (HE) events between the subgenomes, causing changes in genomic composition, gene expression, and phenotypic variations. However, the role of HE in plant adaptation and domestication remains unclear.

pmc-11481709.title: Supplementation of spermidine enhances the quality of postovulatory aged porcine oocytes
pmc-11481709.creator: Jie Bai, Yu Zhang, Na Li, Zhaokang Cui, Hanwen Zhang, Yiting Liu, Yilong Miao, Shaochen Sun, Bo Xiong
pmc-11481709.description: BackgroundSpermidine (SPD) is an intermediate compound in the polyamine metabolism which takes critical part in a variety of cellular processes. In particular, it has been reported to exert anti-aging effects, suppress the age-related diseases, and extend lifespan across species. However, whether it has the favorable influence on the quality of postovulatory aged oocytes remains elusive.

pmc-11534690.title: Combined association of aerobic and muscle strengthening activity with mortality in individuals with hypertension
pmc-11534690.creator: Younghwan Choi, Duck-chul Lee, Yunmin Han, Hoyong Sung, Jiyeon Yoon, Yeon Soo Kim
pmc-11534690.description: Evidence on the association between meeting both aerobic physical activity (PA) and muscle-strengthening activity (MSA) guidelines with mortality in individuals with hypertension is scarce. We included 34,990 adults from the 2007 to 2013 Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, linking mortality follow-up data until 2019.

pmc-11680111.title: Assessment of the Effect of Deleting the African Swine Fever Virus Gene R298L on Virus Replication and Virulence of the Georgia2010 Isolate
pmc-11680111.creator: Elizabeth Ramirez-Medina, Lauro Velazquez-Salinas, Alyssa Valladares, Ediane Silva, Leeanna Burton, Douglas P Gladue, Manuel V Borca, Raymond Rowland
pmc-11680111.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). African swine fever (ASF) is a lethal disease of domestic pigs that is currently challenging swine production in large areas of Eurasia. The causative agent, ASF virus (ASFV), is a large, double-stranded and structurally complex virus. The ASFV genome encodes for more than 160 proteins; however, the functions of most of these proteins are still in the process of being characterized.

pmc-12531773.title: Multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging-based predictive model for chemotherapy response in colorectal cancer patients with gene mutations
pmc-12531773.creator: Wen-Yan Kang, Wen-Ming Deng, Xiao-Qin Ye, Yi-Hong Zhong, Xiao-Jun Li, Ling-Ling Feng, De-Hong Luo
pmc-12531773.description: BACKGROUNDPatients harboring gene mutations like KRAS, NRAS, and BRAF demonstrate highly variable responses to chemotherapy, posing challenges for treatment optimization. Multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), with its non-invasive capability to assess tumor characteristics in detail, has shown promise in evaluating treatment response and predicting therapeutic outcomes.

pmc-12628738.title: Ontogenetic Diversification of Type 2 Conventional Dendritic Cells in the Bone Marrow: A Central Logic for Peripheral Immunity
pmc-12628738.creator: Robert W Baber, Miguel Â Magalhães‐Patrício, Maria V Pires, Vasco Correia, Juan M Lozano‐Gil, João C Guimarães, Chrysothemis C Brown, Marc Dalod, Carlos M Minutti
pmc-12628738.description: Type 2 conventional dendritic cells (cDC2s) are central orchestrators of adaptive immunity. While historically considered a single population shaped by local microenvironments, recent evidence indicates that cDC2s comprise developmentally distinct subsets—cDC2As and cDC2Bs—with divergent ontogeny, tissue distribution, and immune functions.

pmc-12977403.title: Evaluation of 7 modern IOL power calculation formulas in two PARTIAL-Range of Field IOL designs and a new constant optimization method
pmc-12977403.creator: Meiyi Zhu, Zongsheng Zeng, Ziling Zhang, Guangbin Zhang
pmc-12977403.description: PurposeTo evaluate the performance of seven modern intraocular lens (IOL) power calculation formulas in two different PARTIAL-Range of Field (RoF) extend IOL designs, and a novel IOL constant optimization method.Methods200 eyes implanted with Acrysof IQ Vivity or Tecnis Symfony IOL were included. Postoperative refractive outcomes of the Barrett Universal II (BUII), Cooke K6, EVO 2.0, Hill-RBF 3.

pmc-13090161.title: Bioinformatics and Immunohistochemistry Reveal the Diagnostic and Mechanistic Role of the Cuproptosis‐Related Genes SMOC2/THY1 in Liver Fibrosis
pmc-13090161.creator: Ranyan Gao, Hongliang Chen, Jiaxin Wang, Lingyi Xu, Fengchun Li, Xinyu Jiang, Xinyu Geng, Ning Li, Ram Prasad Chaulagain, Babalola Deborah Oluwaseun, Wanwei Li, Shizhu Jin
pmc-13090161.description: Cuproptosis, a newly identified form of programmed cell death, inhibits liver fibrosis in hepatic stellate cells. However, how cuproptosis influences liver fibrosis in other cells remains to be determined. We aimed to develop a diagnostic model for cuproptosis and to further investigate its role in liver fibrosis.

pmc-13595895.title: Synthesis and Surface Engineering of Two‐Dimensional MXenes for Advanced Functional Applications
pmc-13595895.creator: Dalil N. H. Al‐Ghubairi, Hadi M. Marwani, Mahmood D. Aljabri, Muhammad Fazle Rabbee, Mohammed Muzibur Rahman
pmc-13595895.description: Two‐dimensional MXenes (2DMxn), a rapidly expanding family of transition metal carbides, nitrides, and carbonitrides with the general formula (M n + 1X n T x ), have attracted significant attention for their metallic conductivity, hydrophilic surfaces, high surface area, and tunable surface terminations. These unique properties make MXenes promising candidates for applications in catalysis, sensing, energy storage, and environmental remediation.

pmc-13623419.title: Machine learning applications in androgenetic alopecia: a systematic review
pmc-13623419.creator: Jay Huang, Eric McMullen, Sana Gupta, Katya Peri, Miranda Branyiczky, Joy Soliman, Daniel Rayner, Ilya Mukovozov, Jeffrey Donovan
pmc-13623419.description: As applications of artificial intelligence (AI) continue to grow in dermatology, it is necessary to understand the potential of artificial intelligence, including machine learning, in the treatment of androgenetic alopecia. Accordingly, this study aims to evaluate AI applications for AGA diagnosis, severity assessment and predicting treatment outcomes.

uslaw-usc-t12-s1831m.title: 12 U.S.C. § 1831m — Early identification of needed improvements in financial management
uslaw-usc-t12-s1831m.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s1831m.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 16 (Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Annual report on financial condition and management (1) Report required Each insured depository institution shall submit an annual report to the Corporation, the appropriate Federal banking agency, and any appropriate State bank supervisor (including any State bank supervisor of a host State).
